text: どの　ポケモンが　ゆめくいを　おぼえたいん　だい…？

structure.jp: ゆめくいを　おぼえたいんだい…？

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい after a verb stem means 'want to'. おぼえたい = 'want to learn'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: ん is short for の and asks for an explanation; だい is a casual male question ending. おぼえたいんだい = 'is it that you want to learn...?'
